verdict.rationale: Quo's docs show team visibility through a shared number, message history filterable by contact, call history, and call transcripts and summaries. They never explicitly describe a unified per-contact thread combining calls and texts, or contact notes. The contact-filtered history is described through the MCP integration rather than as an in-app contact timeline. missing for 10: explicit per-contact unified call+text thread, contact notes feature, documented team-wide visibility of contact history, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
